question: Which proportional divisions determine the krauḍa wall and hollow space?
premises: Rudra-parts are used for the krauḍa wall
Planet-parts are used for the hollow space
inference: The krauḍa wall and hollow space are measured by Rudra-parts and planet-parts respectively.
uncertainties: Exact numerical values of Rudra-parts and planet-parts are not specified
plain_english: The krauḍa wall is measured by Rudra-parts, and likewise the hollow space by planet-parts.
